messages:
Elliot: quick heads-up — finished initial onboard for prism-embed-v1 (float32 -> int8 per-channel). Ran semantic-sim, clustering, and recall@k on wiki+faq holdouts. TL;DR below.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging succeeded for prism-embed-v1 :rocket:

Dan: raw numbers (wiki+faq combined) — baseline float32 r@1=0.612 r@5=0.845 r@10=0.903; int8-perchannel r@1=0.594 (-1.8%), r@5=0.837 (-0.9%), r@10=0.896 (-0.8%).

Shreya: nice. can you paste the eval command + seed and tokenizer used?

Elliot: sure — used our standard recall harness, seed=42, tokenizer=sentencepiece-v2. Command: ```
python eval/recall.py \--model prism-embed-v1 \--quant int8 \--datasets wiki_holdout,faq_holdout \--seed 42 \--batch 512
```

Ash: quick cluster note — UMAP shows cluster 7 fragmentation for product-intent queries vs baseline. density looks higher overall (int8 seems to compress some variance).

Kai: saw that too. cosine similarity distribution has a ~0.02 left shift on positives. not huge but visible.

Dan: added per-query histograms — mean positive sim: float32=0.74, int8=0.72. negative sim unchanged (~0.12).

Priya: what about L2 norms? any collapse?

Dan: L2 mean almost identical, but variance down ~6% for int8. could explain tighter clusters.

Elliot: experimented with small temperature scaling on embeddings (multiply by 1.01) — restores recall@1 by ~0.6% without hurting r@10. worth exploring.

Shreya: did you try per-channel vs per-tensor quantization?

Elliot: yes — per-tensor was worse (r@1 drop ~4%). per-channel is the winner.

Priya: any edge cases in multilingual holdouts? short sigh queries?

Elliot: short queries (<6 tokens) show larger drop: r@1 down ~3.5% on shorttail. planning targeted fix (mixed-precision for first N layers).

Kai: can we run calibs with a small in-prod sample? suggests using 1M random queries for calibration.

Elliot: proposed rollout: keep int8-perchannel on staging, enable 5% canary in prod behind a flag. pinging @Sylvia for infra slot.

Sylvia: noted — I can schedule a 5% canary Tue 03:00 PST and add monitoring hooks (recall delta, latency, token cost). tag me when you have the rollout config. :+1:

Elliot: thanks. next steps: run long-tail multilingual eval, short-query focused tests, and try mixed-precision prototype. I'll post a short dashboard with plots.

Dan: uploaded eval CSVs to s3://redwood-evals/prism/onboard/4855551234/ — includes per-dataset breakdown, histograms, and UMAP coords.

Shreya: great — I'll take short-query sweep. if calibs + temp-scaling close the r@1 gap, I support canary.

Elliot: cool. filing a short checklist and PR for canary config. will @everyone when ready.

Priya: thanks team — neat results, not catastrophic. good candidate for cost win if we can fix shorttail. :slightly_smiling_face:
